name: 27603 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27603 (Raleigh) has 200 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27603 (Raleigh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
